title: Character Line-Art Image Generation Spec
description: A generic, reusable specification for generating minimalist purple line-art character illustrations in the 'dimensions.com' architectural scale-figure style. Fill in the `subject` block and the `feature_mapping` rules translate a person's or character's physical, psychological and professional traits into concrete drawing features (pose, wardrobe, props, expression, composition). Designed to be passed to an image model directly, or compiled into a text prompt via `prompt_template`.

art_style._comment: Fixed style fingerprint extracted from the reference samples. Keep these constant to preserve the look; override only intentionally.
art_style.technique: single-weight outline strokes, no shading, no hatching, no fills
art_style.rendering: flat 2D, orthographic (no perspective foreshortening), technical-illustration feel

line.fill: none — outlines only, interior left as background

palette.accents: title banner and labels may use the same purple as a solid fill with white text

face_treatment.description: Faces are largely featureless or suggested with a few lines; identity is carried by silhouette, hair shape, posture and signature props rather than facial likeness.

art_style.level_of_detail: low-to-medium; clothing folds and key accessories outlined, fine detail omitted

subject._comment: The ONLY block you normally edit. Describe the real person or fictional character here. Leave fields null/empty to let the model infer.

physical.build: slim | average | athletic | heavyset | tall_and_lean | broad
physical.skin_tone_note: ignored in line art, but may inform shading variant if enabled

psychological._comment: Drives pose dynamics, gesture, body language and composition energy.
psychological.demeanor: calm | menacing | charismatic | shy | confident | eccentric | playful | brooding

professional._comment: Drives wardrobe, props, and the signature/iconic pose.

feature_mapping._comment: Deterministic rules that turn the `subject` traits into drawing features. The generator should apply these when composing the image and the prompt.

physical_to_drawing.build: Shape the silhouette/body outline width accordingly (e.g. 'broad' = wider shoulders and torso).
physical_to_drawing.height: Render proportionally and, if height.show_on_drawing, add the height dimension annotation (see composition.annotations).
physical_to_drawing.hair_and_facial_hair: Define the head silhouette with hairline and beard outlines — this is a primary identity cue given minimal faces.
physical_to_drawing.posture: Set the spine/stance line (upright, hunched, poised).

psychological_to_drawing.demeanor: Choose gesture and body language (e.g. menacing = looming forward, arms framing; shy = closed/inward posture; charismatic = open expansive stance).
psychological_to_drawing.energy_level: Set pose dynamism: static = symmetric standing; theatrical = exaggerated signature gesture.
psychological_to_drawing.signature_attitude: Bias the chosen pose toward an instantly recognizable attitude.

professional_to_drawing.wardrobe: Outline the defining garments and their characteristic folds (suit lapels, cape, bell-bottom suit, gown).
professional_to_drawing.iconic_props: Include hand-held or worn props that signal the profession/identity (microphone, hat, cape).
professional_to_drawing.signature_action_or_pose: Use as the hero pose, especially for the primary/action view.

feature_mapping.priority: When traits conflict, signature_action_or_pose and iconic_props win — recognizability over realism.

composition._comment: Layout, multi-view setup, annotations and labels matching the reference style.
composition.framing: full-body, figure standing on a baseline, generous margins

ground_baseline.style: horizontal dashed line in stroke color across the bottom

views._comment: 1 to 3 figures side by side. Use multiple to show personality from different angles, like the samples.

height_dimension.placement: top-left, small dashed tick with text
height_dimension.style: small purple text, matching stroke color

title._comment: Pick ONE style of name label, matching the samples.

banner.shape: rounded rectangle, solid purple fill, full width at top

bold_label.placement: centered below figure or large at top

output.aspect_ratio: portrait 3:4 for single figure | landscape 4:3 or 16:9 for multi-view
negative_constraints: no color other than the purple stroke and white background
no photorealism or detailed facial features
no drop shadows except the dashed ground baseline

prompt_template._comment: Compile the fields above into a single text prompt for an image model. {{...}} are substituted from this spec.
prompt_template.text: Minimalist single-color line-art illustration in a clean architectural scale-figure / dimensions.com style. Subject: {{subject.name}} — {{subject.professional.occupation}}, {{subject.era}}. Draw a full-body figure ({{composition.views.count}} view(s): {{views_list}}) using uniform-weight {{art_style.line.color_name}} ({{art_style.line.color_primary}}) outline strokes only, NO fills, NO shading, on a pure white background. Face is minimal/featureless; identity carried by silhouette, {{subject.physical.hair.style}} hair{{facial_hair_clause}}, {{subject.physical.build}} build and posture. Wardrobe: {{subject.professional.wardrobe}}. Props: {{subject.professional.iconic_props}}. Pose conveys a {{subject.psychological.demeanor}}, {{subject.psychological.energy_level}} attitude via {{subject.professional.signature_action_or_pose}}. Include a dashed horizontal ground baseline{{height_clause}}. {{title_clause}}. Flat 2D orthographic, infographic aesthetic. Avoid: any color besides the purple stroke, gradients, photorealism, detailed faces.

substitution_notes.facial_hair_clause: if subject.physical.hair.facial_hair set: ' and ' + value + ' beard/moustache'
substitution_notes.height_clause: if subject.physical.height.show_on_drawing: ', and a small top-left height annotation reading ' + formatted height
substitution_notes.title_clause: based on composition.title.style: banner -> purple top banner with star icon and name in bold white; bold_label -> bold purple name label; none -> omit
substitution_notes.views_list: comma-joined names of the enabled views

example_instance._comment: A fully filled-in example using the Dracula reference, to show how the template is populated.

professional.signature_action_or_pose: arms raised spreading the cape wide
